newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran launches new shipping service to UAE.
newsitem.headline: Iran launches new shipping service to UAE.

text.p: Iran launched on Monday a new passenger shipping service to Dubai in the United Arab Emirates, the Iranian news agency IRNA said.
It quoted a local shipping official in Iran's Gulf port city of Bandar Lengeh as saying an Iranian passenger ship would run from the port to Dubai and back once a week.
The vessel can carry 234 passengers, 24 tonnes of cargo and 10 cars, it added.
Iran has a busy cargo traffic, mostly with traditional wooden dhows, and other passenger services to several ports in the UAE, with which it has extensive trade ties.
